framework: Argon 4 Distillation — Real-Time Parliamentary Stream Sieve & 14-Polar Matrix

stream_case_study.speaker: Shadow Minister for Transport
stream_case_study.text: Why are rural highway fatalities rising while regional councils face insolvency over unfunded airport mandates?

stream_case_study.speaker: Minister for Infrastructure (First Answer)
stream_case_study.text: The opposition has no credibility after spending a decade neglecting roads and slashing frontline transport staff!

stream_case_study.speaker: Opposition Leader (Follow-up Attack)
stream_case_study.text: The minister fails to provide a single dollar or strategic explanation for the surging national road toll!

stream_case_study.speaker: Regional Independent Crossbench
stream_case_study.text: I ask the Prime Minister directly: will the government co-fund runway screening and asphalt resurfacing for country towns?

stream_case_study.speaker: Prime Minister
stream_case_study.text: I announce today a $3 billion regional transport safety partnership co-funding rural runways and physical road barrier upgrades.

stream_case_study.speaker: Unfunded Pre-Election Backbencher
stream_case_study.text: We promise that our tax reforms will instantly eliminate all regional living costs and deliver automatic trillion-dollar wealth!

stream_case_study.speaker: Shadow Treasurer
stream_case_study.text: Treasury ledgers reveal $1 billion underspent in Queensland road funds locked in Canberra accounts while bridges deteriorate.

stream_case_study.speaker: Minister for Infrastructure (Statutory Resolution)
stream_case_study.text: The House agrees to the National Transport Safety Bill releasing the full $1 billion reserve under independent auditor general oversight.
